text:
anya: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on GPU supply + autoscale. dropping a short thread for Qs and actions.
sam: APAC ETA for T4 pilot? product needs dates.
anya: Targeting mid-July for APAC T4 burst pools; reserved Dedicated capacity late Q3. Exact zones next week.
nate: How does the autoscaler choose pools when traffic spikes?
anya: Order: reserved -> prewarm -> burst (spot/partners) -> model fallback. That keeps p95 stable for critical routes.
claire: Ops needs prewarm sizing guidance for cloud orders. Any defaults?
anya: Recommend 150 concurrent prewarm slots for major regions; APAC pilot starts at 40 and scales on telemetry.
sam: If spot/burst is evicted, do we silently route to smaller models?
anya: Eviction plan: try prewarm/reserved, then quantized/smaller model variants; only drop if all fallbacks exhausted.
claire: Can we get a short GPU-pressure runbook and on-call matrix?
anya: Action assigned: infra to publish a "GPU pressure playbook" by Friday. Owner: nate.
ate: Will Console show prewarm/burst metrics? SRE needs them.
anya: Yes  Console beta will show prewarm utilization, burst %, and per-route latency in ~2 weeks.
infra-bot: Notes + deck -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3).
anya: Scheduling a 30m follow-up sync Tue 10am PT to map routes and sizing; invite coming. Thanks!
